task.title: Small-data NLP with error analysis
task.prompt: Create a self-contained NLP sentiment classification notebook using a thoughtfully designed synthetic but varied corpus of at least 40 short positive/negative texts (no downloads). Use stratified split, a Pipeline with TfidfVectorizer and LogisticRegression, compare with a simple majority baseline, report precision/recall/F1 and confusion matrix, inspect misclassified texts, and discuss synthetic-data limitations and lexical shortcuts. Include assertions and a plot. Print BENCHMARK_RESULT=<JSON> with task_id, samples, accuracy, f1, baseline_accuracy, misclassified_count.
